explanation: Teri refers to the glossy coat that a glaze of soy sauce, mirin and sugar gives grilled fish or chicken. Cooks brush it on several times as the food grills.

claims.text: In teriyaki, teri means shine or lustre and yaki means grilling or broiling.
Teri does not mean sweet, salty or smoky.
Teriyaki glaze is made from soy sauce, mirin and sugar and gives the food a glossy surface.
The glaze is brushed on repeatedly while the food grills.
